In the initial phase, the role places strong emphasis on hospital setup, system strengthening, and readiness for Maternal and Child Specialized Hospital including CEmONC services. As the facility becomes fully operational, focus progressively shifts toward service optimization, quality improvement, and sustained delivery. Business: Handicap International (HI) is an international aid organization specializing in the field of disability. Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. Since its creation, the organization has set up programmes in approximately 60 countries and intervened in many emergencies. It operates as a federation made up of eight associations (Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Luxembourg, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the USA) that provide human and financial resources, manage projects, and raise awareness of Handicap International`s actions and campaigns.

Handicap International-Humanity & Inclusion (HI) has been working in Bangladesh since 1997, focusing on creating sustainable changes to ensure the rights and inclusion of people with disabilities in society. HI is an independent and impartial aid organization working in Bangladesh in poverty, exclusion, conflict, and disaster situations. With projects in different districts of the country, HI works not only with people with disabilities and other vulnerable populations but also with their families, their communities, and local humanitarian actors to respond to their essential needs, improve their living conditions, promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights, and provide sustainability in its action. As one of the key organizations in the disability sector, HI has a wide range of projects that assist in promoting the inclusion of persons with disabilities and their issues in emergency and development contexts, building the capacities of local stakeholders, and reducing the impact of natural and human-made disasters. Particularly in Cox`s Bazar district, HI is providing services in rehabilitation, MH/PSS, SRH, protection, and inclusive education with an inclusion mainstreaming approach to refugees and host populations affected by the forcibly displaced undocumented Myanmar nationals. HI`s multi-sectoral mobile units (MU) and static method are currently working in 15 camps located in both Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas and surrounding host areas, providing comprehensive services in physical rehabilitation, primary health care, protection, and MHPSS. HI is currently implementing a development and humanitarian response project in Kurigram and Cox`s Bazar district through 3 project offices (Kurigram, Ukhiya, and Teknaf) and 2 coordination offices (Dhaka and Cox Bazar). Operational Thematic: Livelihood, Health and Rehabilitation, Protection, Inclusion, Education, and Atlas Logistics.

Presently, HI Bangladesh is implementing projects on integrating disability in community-based disaster risk reduction and response; economic empowerment of extremely poor persons with disabilities; mainstreaming disability in livelihood interventions; support to refugees and surrounding communities, capacity building of professional associations; and support to disabled people`s organizations, among others.

job_description: Product Costing (Cost Break-Down / CBD) Prepare a detailed Cost Break-Down (CBD) sheet for every product/style prior to quotation or order confirmation, clearly separating four core components: Material, Labour, Overhead, and Profit. Maintain a standardized CBD template/format across all sister concerns to ensure consistency, comparability, and auditability of costing data. Ensure every CBD is supported by documented assumptions (consumption, wastage %, SMV, overhead rate, margin %) so the costing can be defended and re-verified at any time. Material Costing Analyze and validate raw material composition, consumption, and wastage percentage for each item/style to arrive at an accurate material cost. Maintain an updated material price database (fabrics, PU/PVC and other synthetics, trims, accessories, packaging) sourced from approved suppliers, tracking price movements over time. Cross-check supplier-quoted material prices against market benchmarks, historical purchase data, and alternative-supplier quotations before finalizing costing. Labour Costing (Cost of Making) Calculate labour cost (CM) based on SMV (Standard Minute Value)/operation break-down, manpower and machine requirement, and applicable wage rates. Work closely with Industrial Engineering (IE) and Production teams to obtain accurate SMV, line balancing, and efficiency data for costing purposes. Overhead Costing Compute factory overhead allocation (utilities, depreciation, administration, compliance, etc.) per unit/style based on the company's approved overhead absorption methodology. Review and update overhead rates periodically in line with actual factory operating costs and capacity utilization. Profit Margin and Final Costing Apply the appropriate profit margin in line with business unit policy, balancing commercial viability with market competitiveness. Prepare the final CBD-based FOB/landed cost sheet and submit it for management approval before it is shared externally with buyers/brands or used internally for order decisions. Productivity and Efficiency Analysis Maintain a clear, working understanding of productivity per hour / line efficiency (units or SMV produced per hour) across product categories, and ensure it is correctly reflected in the labour cost component of every CBD. Track productivity trends by product/process/line and quantify their cost impact, so costing stays current with actual factory performance rather than outdated assumptions. Supplier Negotiation Use the CBD as the basis for supplier negotiations — challenging cost elements line-by-line (material cost, process/conversion cost, overhead, margin) rather than negotiating on the headline price alone. Build should-cost models for key materials and components to support fact-based negotiation and to identify realistic cost-reduction opportunities with suppliers. Represent the costing function in supplier/vendor negotiation meetings alongside Sourcing/Merchandising, providing cost-break-down justification for target pricing. Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. Since its creation, the organization has set up programmes in approximately 60 countries and intervened in many emergencies. It operates as a federation made up of eight associations (Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Luxembourg, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the USA) that provide human and financial resources, manage projects, and raise awareness of Handicap International`s actions and campaigns.

Handicap International-Humanity & Inclusion (HI) has been working in Bangladesh since 1997, focusing on creating sustainable changes to ensure the rights and inclusion of people with disabilities in society. HI is an independent and impartial aid organization working in Bangladesh in poverty, exclusion, conflict, and disaster situations. With projects in different districts of the country, HI works not only with people with disabilities and other vulnerable populations but also with their families, their communities, and local humanitarian actors to respond to their essential needs, improve their living conditions, promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights, and provide sustainability in its action. As one of the key organizations in the disability sector, HI has a wide range of projects that assist in promoting the inclusion of persons with disabilities and their issues in emergency and development contexts, building the capacities of local stakeholders, and reducing the impact of natural and human-made disasters. Particularly in Cox`s Bazar district, HI is providing services in rehabilitation, MH/PSS, SRH, protection, and inclusive education with an inclusion mainstreaming approach to refugees and host populations affected by the forcibly displaced undocumented Myanmar nationals. HI`s multi-sectoral mobile units (MU) and static method are currently working in 15 camps located in both Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas and surrounding host areas, providing comprehensive services in physical rehabilitation, primary health care, protection, and MHPSS. Islamic Relief Worldwide (IRW) - founded in 1984 and based in Birmingham, UK - is an independent humanitarian and development organization. It supports the world’s most vulnerable people in their fight against poverty & sufferings regardless of race, political affiliation, gender, or belief, and without expecting anything in return. It is a signatory to the Code of Conduct for the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. 
IRW has a presence in 45 countries across the globe. Some funds of the organization come from individual donations and others from institutional donors such as the DFID, EU, SIDA, CIDA/IDRF, Forum Syd, WFP, UNDP, and ECHO.
Islamic Relief(IR) started working in Bangladesh in 1991 in order to help the distressed survivors of the devastating cyclone by providing emergency relief and supporting communities to rebuild in the wake of that cyclone. Initially, it focused on emergency relief & disaster preparedness activities. Later on, it expanded its programs on both humanitarian and development challenges. Now it works in an integrated manner combining emergency humanitarian assistance, short-term work opportunity, shelter support, awareness & training on different DRR, climate change, development, health & hygiene and social issues, cash grant, IGA means, health & nutrition, safe water & sanitation, education, advocacy and linkage with different service providers. As a registered charity, IR is open and transparent; it continually assesses its work and operational methods to improve impact and effectiveness. 
Islamic Relief values and commitment to safeguarding: IRB is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behavior at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults, and beneficiaries with whom IRB engages. IRB expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us. All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records checks. IRW also participates in the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme.
In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment.

job_description: 1. Construction Planning & Project Execution Plan, organize, coordinate, and supervise construction activities from project initiation through completion and handover. Prepare and monitor detailed construction schedules, work programs, manpower plans, and resource requirements. Ensure projects are executed according to approved drawings, specifications, BOQ, budget, and agreed timeline. Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly construction progress and take corrective actions where required. Identify potential delays, technical issues, and construction risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures. Ensure timely completion of project milestones and overall project handover. 2. Site Management & Supervision Supervise Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, contractors, subcontractors, and construction workers. Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, workmanship, productivity, and compliance. Drawing, BOQ & Technical Coordination Review architectural, structural, MEP, and other engineering drawings before execution. Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, engineers, and other technical professionals. Ensure construction activities are carried out strictly according to approved drawings and specifications. 4. Cost Control & Budget Management Assist in preparation and monitoring of project budgets and construction cost estimates. Review BOQ, rate analysis, material requirements, and cost implications of variations. Monitor actual construction costs against approved budgets. Identify opportunities for cost optimization and value engineering without compromising quality. Review and verify contractor/subcontractor bills, measurement sheets, work orders, and payment recommendations. 5. Procurement & Material Management Prepare and review material requirement schedules in coordination with project sites and procurement teams. Ensure timely requisition and availability of construction materials. Verify material specifications, quantities, quality, and compliance with approved requirements. Coordinate with Procurement and Store departments to ensure uninterrupted material supply. Monitor material wastage and take measures to minimize unnecessary losses. 6. Contractor & Subcontractor Management Coordinate and supervise contractors and subcontractors to ensure compliance with project requirements. Monitor contractor performance, productivity, quality, progress, and resource deployment. Evaluate contractor/subcontractor performance and recommend corrective actions when necessary. Verify work measurements and completed works before recommending payments. Maintain professional relationships with contractors, suppliers, consultants, and other stakeholders. 7. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Ensure all construction works comply with approved specifications, drawings, standards, and quality requirements. Establish and monitor quality control procedures for construction activities. Ensure proper testing and inspection of construction materials and completed works. Monitor concrete, reinforcement, masonry, plaster, waterproofing, finishing, and other construction activities. Ensure defects and non-conformities are identified and rectified promptly. Maintain appropriate quality records, inspection reports, and testing documentation. 8. Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance Ensure strict implementation of workplace health and safety requirements at construction sites. Monitor PPE compliance, site safety practices, scaffolding, excavation, lifting operations, electrical safety, fire safety, and emergency arrangements. Identify construction hazards and ensure appropriate risk-control measures are implemented. Coordinate with the HSE/Safety team to reduce accidents, incidents, and unsafe practices. Promote a strong safety culture among employees, contractors, and workers. 9. Regulatory & Compliance Ensure construction activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, approved plans, and building codes. Maintain awareness of applicable  BNBC, RAJUK requirements, fire safety requirements , and other relevant regulatory requirements. Coordinate with relevant authorities, consultants, and stakeholders whenever necessary. Ensure required approvals, inspections, certificates, and project documentation are properly maintained. 10. Reporting & Documentation Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly construction progress reports. Provide management with updates on project progress, cost, quality, manpower, materials, risks, and critical issues. Maintain proper records of drawings, approvals, measurements, variations, work orders, contractor bills, inspections, and correspondence. Prepare management presentations and project performance reports when required. 11. Team Leadership Lead, guide, motivate, and evaluate the construction team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor performance of engineers, supervisors, and site personnel. Identify training and development requirements of construction personnel. Promote teamwork, accountability, discipline, and professional standards within the Construction Department. 12. Project Completion & Handover Coordinate final inspection and completion of construction works. Ensure rectification of all outstanding defects and punch-list items. Coordinate testing, commissioning, documentation, and final handover. Ensure preparation and submission of as-built drawings, completion documents, warranties, and other required records. Support defect-liability-period activities and post-handover requirements.

Business: Handicap International (HI) is an international aid organization specializing in the field of disability. Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. Since its creation, the organization has set up programmes in approximately 60 countries and intervened in many emergencies. It operates as a federation made up of eight associations (Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Luxembourg, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the USA) that provide human and financial resources, manage projects, and raise awareness of Handicap International`s actions and campaigns.

Handicap International-Humanity & Inclusion (HI) has been working in Bangladesh since 1997, focusing on creating sustainable changes to ensure the rights and inclusion of people with disabilities in society. HI is an independent and impartial aid organization working in Bangladesh in poverty, exclusion, conflict, and disaster situations. With projects in different districts of the country, HI works not only with people with disabilities and other vulnerable populations but also with their families, their communities, and local humanitarian actors to respond to their essential needs, improve their living conditions, promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights, and provide sustainability in its action. As one of the key organizations in the disability sector, HI has a wide range of projects that assist in promoting the inclusion of persons with disabilities and their issues in emergency and development contexts, building the capacities of local stakeholders, and reducing the impact of natural and human-made disasters. Particularly in Cox`s Bazar district, HI is providing services in rehabilitation, MH/PSS, SRH, protection, and inclusive education with an inclusion mainstreaming approach to refugees and host populations affected by the forcibly displaced undocumented Myanmar nationals. HI`s multi-sectoral mobile units (MU) and static method are currently working in 15 camps located in both Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas and surrounding host areas, providing comprehensive services in physical rehabilitation, primary health care, protection, and MHPSS. HI is currently implementing a development and humanitarian response project in Kurigram and Cox`s Bazar district through 3 project offices (Kurigram, Ukhiya, and Teknaf) and 2 coordination offices (Dhaka and Cox Bazar). Operational Thematic: Livelihood, Health and Rehabilitation, Protection, Inclusion, Education, and Atlas Logistics.

Presently, HI Bangladesh is implementing projects on integrating disability in community-based disaster risk reduction and response; economic empowerment of extremely poor persons with disabilities; mainstreaming disability in livelihood interventions; support to refugees and surrounding communities, capacity building of professional associations; and support to disabled people`s organizations, among others.

job_description: কাজের উদ্দেশ্য সিমেন্ট পাইপ উৎপাদনের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম তত্ত্বাবধান ও নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা এবং উৎপাদনের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা, পণ্যের গুণমান, জনবলের সঠিক ব্যবহার, মেশিনের দক্ষতা, কর্মক্ষেত্রের নিরাপত্তা ও ন্যূনতম অপচয় নিশ্চিত করা। প্রধান দায়িত্বসমূহ সিমেন্ট পাইপ লাইনের দৈনিক উৎপাদন কার্যক্রম তত্ত্বাবধান করা। উৎপাদনের প্রয়োজনীয়তা এবং মেশিনের কার্যক্রম অনুযায়ী জনবল বণ্টন করা। অনুমোদিত উৎপাদন পরিকল্পনা এবং গুণমানের মানদণ্ড অনুযায়ী উৎপাদন পরিচালিত হচ্ছে কিনা তা নিশ্চিত করা। মেশিনের কার্যক্রম, কাঁচামাল সরবরাহ, মিশ্রণ, গঠন, চাপ প্রয়োগ, কাটা, জমাট বাঁধা এবং চূড়ান্তকরণ প্রক্রিয়া পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। উৎপাদনের পরিমাণ, অপচয়, বাতিল পণ্য, ডাউনটাইম এবং মেশিনের কার্যকারিতা পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। সিমেন্ট, ফাইবার, পাল্প, রাসায়নিক, রঞ্জক এবং অন্যান্য কাঁচামালের সঠিক ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। উৎপাদনের সমস্যা চিহ্নিত করা এবং উৎপাদন/প্রযুক্তি দলের সাথে সমন্বয় করে তাৎক্ষণিক প্রতিকারমূলক ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। সুষ্ঠু উৎপাদনের জন্য রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ, গুণমান নিয়ন্ত্রণ, স্টোর, ইউটিলিটি এবং অন্যান্য বিভাগের সাথে সমন্বয় করা। সমাপ্ত পণ্যের সঠিক ব্যবস্থাপনা, স্তূপীকরণ, জমাট বাঁধা এবং স্থানান্তর নিশ্চিত করা। উৎপাদন রেকর্ড, শিফট রিপোর্ট, ডাউনটাইম রিপোর্ট, অপচয় রিপোর্ট এবং অন্যান্য প্রয়োজনীয় নথি রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা। কর্মীরা যেন স্ট্যান্ডার্ড অপারেটিং প্রসিডিউর (এসওপি), কাজের নির্দেশাবলী এবং নিরাপত্তা বিধি মেনে চলে তা নিশ্চিত করা। উৎপাদন এলাকায় পরিচ্ছন্নতা এবং ৫এস কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। পণ্যের অপচয় নিয়ন্ত্রণ করুন এবং উৎপাদনশীলতা বৃদ্ধি ও উৎপাদন খরচ কমানোর জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় পদক্ষেপ বাস্তবায়নে সহায়তা করা। মেশিন পরিচালনা, উৎপাদন পদ্ধতি, গুণগত মান এবং নিরাপত্তা অনুশীলন সম্পর্কে কর্মীদের প্রশিক্ষণ ও নির্দেশনা দান। মেশিনের অস্বাভাবিকতা, গুণগত সমস্যা, দুর্ঘটনা এবং অন্যান্য পরিচালনগত সমস্যা সম্পর্কে অবিলম্বে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। ব্যক্তিগত সুরক্ষা সরঞ্জাম (পিপিই)-এর সঠিক ব্যবহার এবং প্ল্যান্টের নিরাপত্তা বিধি মেনে চলা নিশ্চিত করা। কাইজেন, উৎপাদনশীলতা বৃদ্ধি এবং ধারাবাহিক উন্নয়ন কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা করা। ব্যবস্থাপনা কর্তৃক অর্পিত অন্য যেকোনো দায়িত্ব পালন করা।

Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. job_description: Company Description Vita Flow Technology Ltd. is a Dhaka-based software company building AI-powered products and services for the Bangladeshi market. Its flagship product, Carenika AI (ai.carenika.com), is Bangladesh's first Bengali clinical documentation platform — doctors speak in Bangla, and the system produces a structured, safety-screened prescription. The company also operates Doctors AI BD, a digital-skills academy for medical students and professionals at ictdictionary.com, and provides custom software development, AI integration, and digital marketing services. Vita Flow Technology is a registered Bangladeshi company headquartered in Dhaka, working at the intersection of health-tech, education, and applied AI. Role Description The Operations & Growth Associate is a full-time role based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, combining office and field work. This position supports the growth of Carenika AI and the company's education programs, focusing on user onboarding, workshop operations, and digital campaigns. Day-to-day responsibilities include onboarding doctors to the platform over the phone and through in-person chamber visits, running online workshops (email invitations, registration management, reminders, and Zoom setup), managing Facebook ad campaigns and tracking daily performance numbers, editing short promotional videos using CapCut, and building and maintaining contact databases of doctors and medical colleges. The Associate will report weekly to the Managing Director, help identify friction points in the product, and contribute directly to user growth targets. The role offers a three-month probation period, after which salary review and a growth path — including a profit-share discussion for strong performers — will follow. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong interpersonal skills and genuine comfort in speaking with strangers, both over the phone and face-to-face, as doctor onboarding is the core of this role. Candidates should possess basic operational skills, including coordination, scheduling, follow-up discipline, and accurate record-keeping in spreadsheets. Candidates should possess practical digital skills — email tools, Zoom, Google Sheets/Excel, and Facebook — and must know CapCut (or similar) video editing. Candidates should possess effective communication skills in both Bangla and English, written and verbal. Candidates should possess a service mindset: responsiveness, patience, and commitment to helping non-technical users (doctors) adopt new technology. A bachelor's degree in any discipline is required; CSE/IT background is beneficial but not mandatory. Basic Laravel/PHP knowledge is an advantage, not a requirement. Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply — attention to detail, eagerness to learn, and willingness to do field visits in Dhaka matter more than experience.

Marker Making & Fabric Utilization: Optimize marker layouts to maximize fabric yield. Sample Development & Fit Approval: Guide sample machinists in constructing proto, size, and Pre-Production (PP) samples. Conduct fit sessions, analyze garment measurements against the spec sheet, and adjust patterns accordingly. Documentation (BOM & SOP): Generate accurate Bills of Materials (BOM). Draft comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and construction manuals, detailing stitch types (e.g., 301, 504), SPI (Stitches Per Inch), seam types (e.g., French seams, flat-felled seams), and specific folding/pressing instructions. Production Preparation & Process Fabric Shrinkage & Relaxation Management: Woven fabrics (especially natural fibers) have varying shrinkage rates. Technical staff must track and calculate shrinkage percentages after washing/steaming and adjust patterns accordingly to ensure final garment dimensions remain within tolerance. Tooling, Attachments & Template Design: Design and fabricate specialized sewing attachments (e.g., binding folders, hemming guides, collar templates) to standardize operations, reduce skill dependency, and ensure uniform quality across all operators. Time Study & Line Balancing (IE Function): Conduct time and motion studies to establish Standard Allowed Minutes (SAM) or Standard Minute Value (SMV) for each operation. Balance the production line to eliminate bottlenecks, ensuring a smooth flow of WIP (Work in Progress). Pre-Production (PP) Meetings: Lead technical handover meetings with production managers, line supervisors, and QA teams. Highlight critical construction points, potential risk areas, and specific quality standards for the upcoming bulk run. On-Site Technical Support & Troubleshooting First Piece Approval: Inspect and approve the "First Piece" off the production line before bulk sewing begins. Verify dimensions, construction methods, visual aesthetics, and hand-feel against the approved PP sample. Real-time Problem Solving: Patrol the sewing and pressing floors to resolve immediate technical issues. Common woven issues include seam puckering, twisted side seams (spirality), uneven hems, collar asymmetry, and fabric distortion. Pressing & Finishing Optimization: Woven garments rely heavily on tailoring and pressing (often summarized in the industry as "30% sewing, 70% ironing"). Technical staff must optimize the use of steam irons, vacuum tables, and pressing molds to achieve the required 3D shape (e.g., shirt collars, suit lapels, trouser creases) without causing fabric shine or scorching. Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement Quality Standard Formulation: Assist the QA department in defining critical Point of Measure (POM) tolerances and AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit) inspection criteria specific to the woven garment category. Root Cause Analysis & CAPA: Investigate bulk quality defects. Perform Root Cause Analysis (e.g., using the 5 Whys or Fishbone diagrams) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to prevent recurrence. Process Innovation & Automation: Introduce advanced machinery (e.g., automatic pocket setters, auto-attach buttonholers, CNC fabric cutters) and software (3D sampling like CLO3D) to modernize the factory, reduce lead times, and lower labor costs.

job_description: Key Responsibilities A. Branch & Operational Audit Conduct periodic and surprise audits of CPF branches covering production, operations, sales, administration, inventory and documentation. Verify key branch performance data including DOC placement, mortality, FCR, body weight, EEF, farm grades, production cost, bird lifting and sales against supporting records. Cross-check branch reports with farm-level records and physical conditions to identify discrepancies, reporting gaps or irregularities. Verify implementation of management instructions, approved policies and operational procedures and follow up on previous audit observations. B. Farm Audit & Physical Verification Conduct regular and surprise physical audits of contract and rental farms. Verify bird population, mortality, feed consumption, medicine/vaccine usage, body weight and farm records against reported figures. Assess farm management practices including brooding, feeding, watering, litter, ventilation, biosecurity, vaccination and seasonal management. Verify Field Executive farm visits and effectiveness of technical supervision. Identify high-mortality, high-FCR and E/F Grade farms and investigate operational or management causes. Verify rental farm existence, capacity, utilization and compliance with approved arrangements. C. Accounts & Financial Audit Audit petty cash, operational expenses, farmer payments, trader/customer collections and other branch financial transactions. Verify vouchers, bills, approvals and supporting documents against company policies and approved budgets. Verify cash balances, farmer/trader ledgers, outstanding amounts and payment/collection records wherever applicable. Identify unauthorized expenditure, duplicate/unsupported claims, abnormal transactions or other financial irregularities. Immediately report suspected fraud, misappropriation, manipulation or serious financial irregularities to management. D. Inventory & Stock Audit Physically verify vaccines, medicines, disinfectants, equipment and other consumables against stock/system records. Verify stock receipt, issue, transfer, consumption, return, damage and expiry records. Ensure FIFO/FEFO, proper storage, cold-chain and inventory hygiene compliance. Investigate abnormal consumption, shortages/excesses, expired products and unexplained stock variances. E. Survey, Market and Industry Analysis Farm Survey: Conduct surveys of existing and potential farms to assess farm capacity, infrastructure, production capability, management practices, geographical suitability, and opportunities for CPF expansion. Area Survey: Conduct area-based surveys to identify suitable locations for farm expansion, rental farms, production growth, infrastructure availability, transportation facilities, biosecurity risks, and overall operational potential. Market Survey: Conduct market surveys to analyze poultry demand, market prices, competitor activities, trader/customer potential, sales opportunities, consumption patterns, and new market expansion possibilities. Follow up with responsible personnel until major audit observations and SOP deviations are satisfactorily closed. F. Sales, Bird Lifting & Documentation Audit Verify bird lifting and sales records including quantity, weight, rate, trader/customer details and delivery documents. Cross-check sales rates against approved/RO rates and investigate abnormal rate, weight or mortality variations. Review trader/customer outstanding balances, collections and adherence to approved payment terms. Verify completeness and accuracy of farmer agreements, flock records, vaccination records, stock registers, sales records and expense documents. Cross-check physical records, MIS/system data and actual field conditions for consistency and accuracy. G. Maintain an Audit Observation & CAPA Tracker with responsible person, target completion date and closure status. Conduct follow-up verification to ensure corrective actions are effectively implemented.

job_description: Position Overview The CCTV Technician will be responsible for  electrical wiring, CAT6 network cabling, CCTV camera installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and technical support . The technician must complete all work safely, neatly, professionally, and according to approved drawings, project specifications, client requirements, and company standards. Key Job Responsibilities Electrical Wiring & Power Connection Carry out electrical wiring for CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR, network switches, VMS servers, racks, monitors, and related security equipment. Install and connect electrical power cables from designated power sources to CCTV equipment. Install and connect MCBs, distribution boards, power sockets, switches, junction boxes, and power adapters where required. Route electrical cables through PVC/GI conduits, flexible conduits, cable trays, trunking, and approved pathways. Maintain proper phase, neutral, and earth connections. Provide proper grounding/earthing for CCTV equipment, racks, power supplies, and outdoor equipment where required. Check voltage supply before connecting sensitive CCTV and networking equipment. Identify and rectify loose connections, short circuits, power interruption, improper termination, and other electrical issues. Follow all applicable electrical safety procedures and client HSE requirements. CAT6 Network Cabling Install CAT6/CAT6A UTP network cable for IP cameras, NVRs, VMS servers, PoE switches, access control systems, and other network devices. Route CAT6 cables through cable trays, conduits, trunking, ceiling pathways, and wall conduits. Maintain proper separation between CAT6 data cables and electrical power cables. Maintain proper cable bending radius and avoid excessive pulling, crushing, kinking, or sharp bends. Label and identify cables from each camera location to the communication rack. Terminate RJ45 connectors, keystone jacks, patch panels, and network outlets. Follow T568A or T568B wiring standards consistently. Avoid unnecessary joints, splices, or damaged cable sections. Provide suitable service loops at camera and rack locations. CAT6 Testing & Certification Test completed CAT6 cables using professional network cable testers. Verify wire mapping, continuity, pair sequence, open circuit, short circuit, crossed pair, and other cable faults. Identify and rectify poor termination and cable connection problems. Support Fluke or equivalent cable certification testing where required. Maintain and submit cable testing reports where applicable. CCTV Camera Installation Install IP cameras, dome cameras, bullet cameras, PTZ cameras, thermal cameras, and other CCTV cameras. Install camera brackets, poles, junction boxes, outdoor housings, cable glands, conduits, and related accessories. Pull and terminate CAT6 and power cables for each camera. Perform camera alignment, focusing, field-of-view adjustment, and image positioning. Ensure outdoor camera connections are properly weatherproofed and protected. Verify camera mounting stability and professional cable management. CCTV Camera Troubleshooting Diagnose and resolve CCTV camera faults, communication problems, image problems, and power-related issues. Troubleshoot cameras that are offline, disconnected, showing video loss, receiving no PoE power, or experiencing intermittent connectivity. Troubleshoot blurred, distorted, noisy, flickering, black/blank, or poor-quality video. Troubleshoot IR/night-vision, date/time, recording, and configuration issues. Check camera power supply, PoE port, CAT6 cable, RJ45 termination, switch port, IP address, and network connectivity. Verify camera configuration including IP address, subnet mask, gateway, DNS, NTP, resolution, frame rate, bitrate, encoding, and recording settings. Troubleshoot duplicate IP and network communication issues. Check ONVIF or applicable camera protocol compatibility. Replace defective cameras, connectors, cables, PoE ports, power supplies, or other faulty components where required. Perform authorized camera reset, reconfiguration, firmware update, and NVR/VMS re-registration. Verify live view, recording, playback, remote viewing, and analytics after troubleshooting. Maintain proper troubleshooting and service records. NVR / DVR / VMS Troubleshooting Troubleshoot camera connection and recording problems in NVR, DVR, and VMS platforms. Add, remove, modify, and reconfigure cameras. Check recording schedules, storage status, HDD health, user permissions, and playback functionality. Troubleshoot communication between cameras, PoE switches, NVRs, servers, and monitoring workstations. Support remote viewing and network access configuration. Rack, Patch Panel & Switch Cabling Install and organize CAT6 cables inside network and CCTV racks. Terminate cables into patch panels and connect them to PoE/network switches using patch cords. Maintain accurate rack, patch-panel, and switch-port labeling. Perform professional cable dressing using Velcro straps, cable managers, and other accessories. Maintain proper separation between power and data cabling. Testing, Commissioning & Maintenance Test every CCTV camera and associated equipment after installation. Verify live view, recording, playback, camera coverage, night vision, remote access, and analytics functions. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR, VMS, PoE switches, racks, and cabling. Check connectors, cable conditions, power supplies, storage status, and network connectivity. Conduct final system testing before handover. Safety Responsibilities Follow company and client HSE requirements at all times. Attend mandatory HSE induction before working at client sites where applicable. Use appropriate PPE, including safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, safety harness, and eye protection. Follow safe procedures for electrical work, ladder use, scaffolding, and work-at-height activities. Maintain a clean and safe working environment. Documentation & Reporting Maintain camera installation records and cable identification schedules. Record camera IP addresses, locations, rack numbers, patch-panel ports, and switch ports. Prepare cable testing, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting reports. Report material shortages, defective equipment, site obstacles, and technical issues to the supervisor/project engineer. Assist in preparing as-built drawings and final handover documentation. Job Standard The selected technician must be able to independently perform or effectively support  electrical wiring, CAT6 cabling, CCTV camera installation, camera troubleshooting, NVR/DVR/VMS configuration, testing, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and technical service work  while maintaining professional quality, safety, and customer satisfaction.

Skills Development and Economic Inclusion covers technical and higher-level training, English and life skills, digital and financial literacy, employment and self-employment support, business grants, and Green Innovation Hubs. Female Hygiene Materials and Social Business covers FHM and craft production, safe wage-earning opportunities, quality systems, and responsible market linkages. Together, the components seek to strengthen self-reliance, economic inclusion, accountability, and community empowerment. Working under the overall field-level supervision of the Regional Coordinator and with guidance from the Project Focal, the PC will ensure timely implementation in line with the approved Project Work Plan, Results Plan, Financial Plan, UNHCR requirements, Government approvals, and CNRS policies and procedures. The PC will coordinate the project team and maintain regular operational communication with UNHCR, government authorities, sectoral platforms, partners, and CNRS support functions, in consultation with the Regional Coordinator and Project Focal. The position will be accountable for programme delivery, quality, budget discipline, safeguarding, data protection, risk management, reporting, and achievement of the agreed outputs and indicators. Coordinate project activities, teams, locations, facilities, and resources to ensure timely delivery against agreed outputs, indicators, budgets, and quality standards. Lead regular work-planning and progress-review meetings, assign responsibilities, follow up agreed actions, and address implementation gaps in consultation with the Regional Coordinator and Project Focal. Maintain coordination with UNHCR, relevant government authorities, sectoral platforms, partners, and service providers. Represent CNRS in project-related forums when delegated by the Regional Coordinator or Project Focal. Supervise project staff, review performance, provide guidance, strengthen teamwork and staff capacity, and promote coordination across the three components. Identify operational and programme risks, maintain mitigation and contingency measures, and promptly escalate major issues to the Regional Coordinator and Project Focal. Ensure accountability to affected people, Age, Gender and Diversity principles, safeguarding, PSEA, staff and participant safety, accessible feedback mechanisms, and timely reporting of incidents or concerns. 2. পরিদর্শন করা। বাৎসরিক বাজেট ও কর্মপরিকল্পনা প্রস্তুতে সহায়তা করা্ পরিকল্পিত কর্মসূচী সমূহ যথাযথভাবে বাস্তবায়ন করার লক্ষ্যে মাস ভিত্তিক কর্মপরিকল্পনা তৈরি করা এবং প্রতি মাসের 1 তারিখের মধ্যে কো-অর্ডিনেটর/সহকারী পরিচালক (এম.এফ)এর নিকট জমা দেওয়া। সরেজমিনে পরিদর্শন করে নতুন সমিতি অনুমোদন দেওয়া। মাসে কমপক্ষে 20 টি সমিতি সরেজমিনে পরিদর্শন করে পাশ বই যাচাই করা এবং মাই্গ্রেশন সীট তৈরি করা। পরিদর্শনে প্রাপ্ত ক্রুটি সমূহের সমাধানে ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ এবং কারণ দর্শানো ব্যাখা চাওয়া। ক্ষুদ্র উদ্যেগী ঋণের প্রকল্প সরেজমিনে পরিদর্শন করে নির্দিষ্ট সিলিং পর্যান্ত ঋণ অনুমোদন দেওয়া এবং সিলিং অতিরিক্ত ঋণ অনুমোদনের জন্য সুপারিশ করা। প্রধান কার্যালয় হতে প্রেরিত সিদ্ধান্ত সমূহ আওতাধীন শাখা সমূহে অবগত করে তা বাস্তবায়নে দ্রুত পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া। আওতাধীন শাখা সমুহের কর্মসুচীর পরিকল্পনা প্রণয়ন এবং অনুমোদিত পরিকল্পনা মাঠ পর্যায়ে নিশ্চিতকল্পে কার্যকর পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণ করা। আওতাধীন শাখা সমুহের সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক অগ্রগতি বিশ্লেষন, শাখায় অবস্থান করে অধীনস্থদের মাধ্যমে করণীয় সমুহ বাস্তবায়ন করার ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া। নির্ধারিত কর্মপরিকল্পনা অনুযায়ী শাখা অফিস, সমিতি ও ঋণের প্রকল্প পরিদর্শন করে অনিয়ম/সমস্যা সমূহ চিহ্নিত করে এতদবিষয়ক সমাধানের কার্যকর ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। আওতাধীন শাখা সমূহের বকেয়া আদায়ের জন্য মাঠ পর্যায়ে সার্বিক সহযোগীতা করা। সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক প্রতিবেদন, তথ্যে এবং অন্যান্য চিঠিপত্র সংগ্রহ যাচাই-বাছাই করে জোন অফিস/প্রধান কার্যালয়ে প্রেরণ করা। শাখা অফিসের সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক স্টাফ সভায় অংশগ্রহণ করে লক্ষ্যমাত্রা অর্জনের অগ্রগতি বিষয়ে কার্যকর ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। এরিয়ার আওতাধীন সকল শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকদের সমন্বয়ে মাসিক সভা পরিচালনা ও মাসিক কার্যক্রমের অগ্রগতি পর্যালোচনা করে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকদের নিকট হতে কাজের জবাবদিহীতা নিশ্চিত করা। আওতাধীন শাখা সমুহের কর্মরত স্টাফদের অনিয়মের বিষয়ে ব্যাখা/কারণ দর্শানোর নোটিশ প্রদান পুর্বক প্রশাসনিক ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণের জন্য সুপারিশসহ জোন অফিস/প্রধান কার্যালয়ে প্রেরণ করা। আওতাধীন শাখা সমুহের অফিসারদের নৈমিত্তিক ছুটি 3 দিন এবং ব্যবস্থাপকদের নৈমিত্তিক ছুটি 2 দিন পর্যন্ত অনুমোদন করবেন এবং অন্যান্য ছুটির বিষয়ে সুপারিশ করে অনুমোদনের জন্য জোন অফিস/প্রধান কার্যালয়ে প্রেরণ করা। শাখা অফিস পরিদর্শনকালে শাখার কাগজপত্রাদি নিরীক্ষা করে সঠিকতা নিশ্চিত সাপেক্ষে স্বাক্ষর করা। অধীনস্থদের উপযুক্ত দিক নির্দেশনা দিয়ে সংস্থার নীতি ও আদর্শ অনুযায়ী গড়ে তোলা। অধীনস্থদের কাজের মুল্যায়ন ও সুষম বন্টন নিশ্চিত করা। শাখার তহবিল ব্যবস্থাপনা নিশ্চিত করা ও ব্যাংক হিসাবের সিগনেটরি থাকা এবং ব্যাংক হিসাব যাচাই করা। সফট্ওয়্যারের মাধ্যমে মনিটরিং করা। দুর্বল কর্মী চিহ্নিত করে দক্ষতা বৃদ্ধির জন্য যথাযথ ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করা। এলাকাভূক্ত শাখার 03 বছর পুর্ণ হয়েছে এমন অধীনস্থদের বদলীর প্রস্তাব করা। ঊর্দ্ধতন অফিস ও শাখা অফিসের সাথে সমন্বয় করা। স্থানীয় প্রশাসন ও কর্মএলাকার ব্যক্তিবর্গের সাথে যোগাযোগ রক্ষা তথা সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা। আওতাধীন শাখা সমূহের সকল সম্পদের সুরক্ষা নিশ্চিত করা। কর্মসুচী সম্প্রসারণে সহযোগীতা করা। নিজ ক্ষমতার বাহিরে সকল বিষয়ে উর্দ্ধতন কর্মকর্তার অনুমোদন নেওয়া। Standard confidentiality and contractor agreement before starting.

This consultancy will conduct a comprehensive assessment of risks to MPAs posed by maritime extractive industries (excluding fisheries), focusing on marine hydrocarbons (oil and gas) and offshore mineral extraction, particularly in the Swatch of No Ground and Nijhum Dwip Marine Regions. The consultancy will also provide guidance for the later development of a Risk Mitigation Strategy to guide WCS and government partners in addressing threats from these industries to MPAs and the broader marine environment. Objectives Conduct a comprehensive assessment of current and planned maritime extractive industries in Bangladesh’s waters. Identify risks and potential impacts of these industries on MPAs and other conservation areas, particularly in the regions in and around Swatch of No Ground and Nijhum Dwip MPAs. Oversee and provide technical guidance to the WCS Legal advisor conducting a legislative gap analysis relevant to maritime extractive industries and environmental governance. Provide a high-level guidance on the structure and components of a future Risk Mitigation Strategy Scope of Work / Tasks The consultancy will focus on two interrelated workstreams: Technical Assessment, and Policy and Strategy Guidance. The roles are expected to combine the review of existing policies, analysis, environmental and social safeguards, strategic planning, and formulation of draft strategies for strengthening a national framework for marine conservation planning to ensure adequate long-term protection from maritime extractive industries especially oil and gas sector. Technical Assessment of Maritime Extractive Industries Conduct a review of existing offshore oil, gas, and mineral extraction policies, legal framework, plans and activities, including main associated environmental, operational, social, economic, and health and safety risks. Analyze current and planned licensing and tender processes for offshore development blocks. Based on existing information and contacts with key stakeholders especially Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla), Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources, any other government or private sectors, review available information that might indicate the location of potential reserves. Based on the information outlined above, conduct a spatial analysis to identify areas of overlap or potential conflict between extractive industry activities and existing or proposed MPA, particularly in the Swatch of No Ground and Nijhum Dwip Marine Regions. Assess management plan provisions for existing Swatch of No Ground and Nijhum Dwip MPAs and identify opportunities to incorporate explicit exclusion zones or restrictions on oil and gas extraction. Develop a ‘menu of technical solutions’ and an “action plan” to strengthen MPA management in light of potential oil and gas exploration pressures. Policy and Engagement Guidance Review policy and legal frameworks (e.g., wildlife, fisheries and environment acts and rules, EIA legislation, and any other offshore resource laws or policies) relevant to extractive industries and conservation. Oversee and provide inputs to the WCS Legal advisor conducting a detailed legislative gap analysis to identify policy reform opportunities and governance entry points. Provide strategic recommendations for engaging government counterparts (e.g., Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources; Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change; Petrobangla) to ensure that MPA core zones are protected from extractive activities. Outline an action plan for advancing dialogue and policy reform toward exclusion of oil and gas extraction from MPAs. Framework for Risk Mitigation Strategy Based on assessment findings, provide a draft framework to WCS on the proposed structure or table of contents for a future Risk Mitigation Strategy Plan. job_description: দুঃস্থ স্বাস্থ্য কেন্দ্র (DSK)  ১৯৮৮ সাল থেকে বাংলাদেশের নগর ও পল্লী অঞ্চলে দরিদ্র জনগণের জন্য উন্নয়নমূলক ও আর্থ-সামাজিক কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করছে। DSK মাইক্রোক্রেডিট রেগুলেটরী অথরিটি (MRA) কর্তৃক সনদপ্রাপ্ত (সনদ নং-৩৬৯)। পল্লী কর্ম-সহায়ক ফাউণ্ডেশন (PKSF), বাণিজ্যিক ব্যাংক ও অন্যান্য দাতা সংস্থার সহযোগিতায় DSK ১৯৯৩ সাল থেকে ক্ষুদ্র ঋণ কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করে আসছে। DSK ঋণ কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার জন্য নিম্নলিখিত পদে যোগ্যতাসম্পন্ন প্রার্থীদের নিকট দরখাস্ত আহবান করছে। দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য: দুঃস্থ স্বাস্থ্য কেন্দ্র (ডিএসকে)’র ঋণ-বিধিমালা অনুযায়ী ঋণ কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। সাপ্তাহিক, মাসিক, বার্ষিক পরিকল্পনা প্রস্তুত এবং ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষ বরাবরে দাখিল করা। শাখার সার্বিক কার্যক্রম তত্বাবধান, শাখায় দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত কর্মীর কাজ পরিদর্শন, এবং সহযোগিতা করা। সাপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক সভা পরিচালনা ও প্রয়োজনীয় দিক নির্দেশনা প্রদান করা। প্রতিমাস শেষে অনলাইন ভিত্তিক নির্দিষ্ট ফরমেটে মাসিক প্রতিবেদন তৈরী, যাচাই ও বিশ্লেষণ করে যথাসময়ে ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট প্রেরণ করা। জরিপের মাধ্যমে নতুন কর্মএলাকা নির্বাচন করা এবং সরেজমিনে যাচাই বাছাই করে সদস্য ভর্তি করা। ঋণ প্রস্তাব পরবর্তী শতভাগ যাচাই-বাছাই নির্ভুলভাবে সম্পন্ন করে ঋণদান নিশ্চিত করা। ঋণ কার্যক্রম সম্পর্কিত সকল প্রকার হিসাব সফটওয়্যারে সঠিকভাবে পোস্টিং হচ্ছে কিনা তা নিশ্চিত করা। স্থানীয় প্রশাসন এবং গণ্যমান্য ব্যক্তিবর্গের সাথে সুসম্পর্ক রাখা এবং সংস্থার প্রতিনিধিত্ব করা। সংস্থার আদর্শ, উদ্দেশ্য, মূল্যবোধ এবং প্রচলিত নিয়ম-নীতি মেনে চলা এবং অফিসে সুষ্ঠু কাজের পরিবেশ নিশ্চিত করা। মটর সাইকেল চালনা জানতে হবে এবং বৈধ লাইসেন্স থাকতে হবে।

job_description: Job Location বাড়ি নং: ১৩, ইউএসবি স্পেশালাইজড হাসপাতাল, ঈশাখাঁ এভিনিউ রোড, সেক্টর: ০৬, উত্তরা, ঢাকা-১২৩০। Job Context ইউএসবি স্পেশালাইজড হাসপাতাল -এর General Ward, ICU, NICU, OT, Emergency ও সংশ্লিষ্ট বিভিন্ন বিভাগে নিরাপদ, মানসম্মত ও মানবিক স্বাস্থ্যসেবা নিশ্চিত করার লক্ষ্যে দক্ষ, দায়িত্বশীল ও সেবাপরায়ণ Staff Nurse নিয়োগ করা হবে। রোগীকেন্দ্রিক সেবা, পেশাগত দক্ষতা এবং আধুনিক কর্মপরিবেশে কাজ করার এটি একটি চমৎকার সুযোগ। Job Responsibilities রোগীদের নিরাপদ, সহানুভূতিশীল এবং এভিডেন্স-ভিত্তিক নার্সিং সেবা প্রদান করা। ​ওষুধ প্রয়োগ, নার্সিং ডকুমেন্টেশন এবং রিপোর্টিং যথাযথভাবে সম্পন্ন করা। রোগীর ভাইটাল সাইন মনিটর করা, শারীরিক অবস্থার মূল্যায়ন করা এবং কোনো পরিবর্তন দেখা দিলে দ্রুত তা জানানো। নির্ভুল নার্সিং ডকুমেন্টেশন এবং রোগীর রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। ​Infection Prevention & Control (IPC) নীতিমালা কঠোরভাবে অনুসরণ করা। যেকোনো মেডিকেল ইমার্জেন্সি ও জটিল পরিস্থিতিতে কার্যকরভাবে সাড়া দেওয়া। ক্লিনিক্যাল প্রসিডিউর এবং রোগী ব্যবস্থাপনায় চিকিৎসকদের সহায়তা করা। চিকিৎসা পরিকল্পনা ও স্বাস্থ্য ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কে রোগী ও তাদের পরিবারকে সচেতন করা। মানসম্মত রোগী সেবা নিশ্চিত করতে মাল্টিডিসিপ্লিনারি বা বহুমুখী স্বাস্থ্যসেবা দলের সাথে সহযোগিতা করা। দক্ষতার সাথে শিফট হ্যান্ডওভার সম্পন্ন করা এবং রোগীর সেবার ধারাবাহিকতা নিশ্চিত করা। ​হাসপাতালের পেশাগত আচরণবিধি, গোপনীয়তা নীতি এবং সকল প্রশাসনিক নির্দেশনা মেনে চলা।

job_description: Oriental Group is seeking a  semi-experienced, highly detail-oriented Internal Auditor  to oversee internal financial and operational controls across the Group's businesses, including real estate, construction, manufacturing, procurement, stores and other operating units. The primary responsibility of this position will be to  identify financial leakage, prevent fraud and irregularities, verify purchases and expenses, and ensure that company funds and materials are being used properly and efficiently. This is a hands-on role requiring the candidate to independently review bills, purchase orders, supplier quotations, inventory records, project expenses and financial transactions. Key Responsibilities 1. Bill & Payment Verification Review supplier bills, purchase bills, expense claims, invoices and payment requests before or after payment. Verify that quantities, prices, taxes, discounts and supporting documents are accurate. Match  Purchase Orders, Goods Received Notes (GRN), invoices and payment records . Identify duplicate, inflated, fictitious or unsupported bills. Verify that payments are made only against genuine purchases and approved transactions. Check whether payments comply with company approval procedures. 2. Procurement & Raw Material Price Audit Regularly compare prices of raw materials, construction materials, machinery, spare parts and other purchases against: Previous purchase prices Current market prices Alternative supplier quotations Approved supplier rates Identify unusual price increases or unexplained price differences. Review supplier quotations and procurement processes to ensure competitive pricing. Maintain a database of frequently purchased materials and their market/reference prices. Flag suspicious supplier relationships, unusual purchasing patterns or potential conflicts of interest. 3. Construction Site & Project Audit Conduct regular physical visits to Oriental Group's construction sites. Verify materials received at site against purchase orders and delivery documents. Check whether materials are actually being used for the stated project. Identify wastage, shortages, unauthorized removal or misuse of materials. Compare project budgets against actual expenditure. Review contractor bills, subcontractor bills and variation claims. Physically verify quantities of major materials such as steel, cement, bricks, tiles, electrical materials, sanitary items and other construction inputs. 4. Inventory & Store Audit Conduct periodic and surprise physical inventory counts. Reconcile physical stock with store records and accounting records. Investigate shortages, excess inventory and unexplained adjustments. Review material receiving and issuing procedures. Ensure proper documentation for movement of materials between sites, factories and warehouses. Monitor slow-moving, obsolete or damaged inventory. 5. Fraud & Financial Crime Prevention Identify potential fraud, theft, embezzlement, kickbacks, conflicts of interest and unauthorized transactions. Investigate unusual transactions and financial discrepancies. Review transactions for suspicious patterns or manipulation. Maintain strict confidentiality regarding investigations. Escalate suspected financial misconduct immediately to senior management. Develop and recommend controls to prevent recurring irregularities. 6. Vendor & Supplier Review Review new and existing suppliers for proper documentation and approval. Identify unusual concentration of purchases with specific suppliers. Compare supplier pricing with alternative suppliers and market rates. Investigate repeated purchases made without competitive quotations. Review potential related-party or conflict-of-interest relationships. 7. Financial & Operational Controls Review internal controls across Group companies and departments. Identify weaknesses in procurement, payment, inventory, payroll and expense processes. Recommend stronger approval and documentation procedures. Ensure proper segregation of duties. Monitor compliance with company policies and delegated authority limits. 8. Reporting Prepare regular  Internal Audit Reports  for senior management. Report financial discrepancies, control weaknesses and potential fraud. Quantify financial exposure wherever possible. Provide practical recommendations to reduce costs and prevent leakage. Maintain an audit trail of all findings and management responses. Follow up to ensure corrective actions have actually been implemented. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The successful candidate will be evaluated based on: Amount of unnecessary expenditure identified or prevented. Procurement price discrepancies identified. What We Are Looking For Oriental Group is looking for someone who can effectively act as the  "eyes and ears" of senior management  across the Group—someone who can identify where money or materials may be leaking, determine whether purchases are being made at reasonable market prices, and establish controls that prevent financial irregularities before they occur. তদারকি করা। SR-দের দৈনিক বাজার ভিজিট ও কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। সেল্স টিম এর দৈনিক, সপ্তাহিক ও মাসিক টার্গেট নির্ধারণ ও অনুসরণ করা। নিয়মিত মার্কেট ভিজিট করে SR-দের কাজের মান ও কার্যক্রম যাচাই করা। কার্যক্রম পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর-এর বকেয়া ও কালেকশন পরিস্থিতি নিয়মিত পর্যবেক্ষণ করা। ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর-এর সমস্যা ও চাহিদা দ্রুত সমাধানের জন্য সংশ্লিষ্ট বিভাগে সমন্বয় করা। মার্কেট ডেভেলপমেন্ট নতুন মার্কেট, নতুন গ্রাহক ও নতুন বিক্রয় পয়েন্ট তৈরি করা। টেরিটরির মার্কেট কভারেজ বৃদ্ধি করা। রিটেইলার, পাইকারি বিক্রেতা, ডিস্ট্রিবিউটর ও কাস্টমার এর সঙ্গে সুসম্পর্ক বজায় রাখা। কোম্পানির পণ্যের সঠিক মাসিক সেলস রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত ও জমা দেওয়া। মার্কেট ভিজিট রিপোর্ট, সেলস ফরকাস্ট, স্টক রিপোর্ট, যথাসময়ে প্রদান করা। টেরিটরির সেলস পারফর্মেন্স, মার্কেট বৃদ্ধি ও বিক্রয় লক্ষমাত্রা অর্জন সম্পর্কে ঊর্ধ্বতন job_description: Job Context:  Sentry Security Services Ltd. is looking for an experienced, commercially minded and result-oriented finance professional for the position of Manager – Accounts & Finance. The incumbent will be responsible for managing the company`s day-to-day accounting and financial operations, financial reporting, budgeting, cash-flow management, receivables and payables, payroll-related financial controls, taxation/VAT coordination, audit support and internal financial controls. The position will work closely with the Managing Director/Management, Finance & Accounts Team, HR & Administration, Operations, Procurement, Sales & Business Development and external auditors, banks and regulatory authorities. The successful candidate should have strong hands-on experience in accounting and financial management and the ability to manage finance operations for a large, service-oriented organization with multiple clients and operational locations. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial & Accounting Management Manage the day-to-day Accounts & Finance functions of Sentry Security Services Ltd. Ensure proper recording, classification and reconciliation of all financial transactions. Supervise general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash and bank transactions. Ensure timely preparation and review of vouchers, journals, ledgers and supporting documentation. Maintain accurate and complete books of accounts in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies. Review monthly closing activities and ensure timely completion of accounting processes. Ensure proper documentation and authorization of financial transactions. 2. Financial Reporting Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and management reports. Prepare income statements, balance sheets, cash-flow statements and other financial schedules. Provide management with accurate and timely financial information for decision-making. Prepare financial analysis relating to revenue, costs, profitability, receivables, expenses and cash flow. Develop management dashboards and financial performance reports where required. Identify significant variances and recommend corrective actions. client onboarding. 3. Budgeting & Financial Planning Coordinate preparation of the annual operating budget. Assist management in preparing financial forecasts and business plans. Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets. Analyze budget variances and recommend cost-control measures. Prepare financial projections for new contracts, projects and business opportunities. Support management in assessing the financial viability and profitability of new contracts. 4. Accounts Receivable & Client Billing Supervise timely preparation and submission of client invoices. Ensure accurate billing in accordance with contractual terms. Monitor outstanding receivables and maintain an updated collection schedule. Coordinate with the Sales, Operations and Client-Service Teams regarding billing discrepancies. Follow up on overdue receivables and support timely collection. Prepare monthly receivables ageing reports. Monitor client advances, security deposits, adjustments and other receivable balances. 5. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management Supervise vendor and supplier payments. Verify invoices, supporting documents, approvals and contractual terms before payment. Maintain accurate accounts payable ageing. Ensure payments are made according to approved payment schedules. Coordinate with Procurement and Administration regarding vendor-related financial matters. Maintain proper records of supplier balances and payment commitments. 6. Cash & Bank Management Monitor daily cash and bank balances. Prepare cash-flow forecasts and ensure adequate liquidity for operational requirements. Supervise bank reconciliation statements. Coordinate with banks regarding account operations, statements, payment instruments and other banking matters. Monitor bank charges, interest, loans and other financial transactions. Maintain appropriate cash-management controls. 7. Payroll & Employee-Related Financial Control Coordinate with HR and Payroll Teams to ensure accurate and timely salary processing. Review payroll-related financial information and supporting schedules. Ensure proper accounting of salaries, allowances, bonuses, deductions and employee-related liabilities. Coordinate financial arrangements relating to employee benefits and statutory payments. Ensure payroll-related reconciliations are completed on time. 8. VAT, Tax & Regulatory Compliance Supervise accounting support for applicable VAT and income-tax compliance. Coordinate preparation and submission of relevant VAT/tax returns and statements with the responsible tax/VAT professionals. Ensure proper maintenance of VAT and tax documentation. Monitor withholding tax/TDS/TCS requirements as applicable. Maintain records required for tax/VAT audits and regulatory inspections. Liaise with external tax/VAT consultants and relevant authorities when required. 9. Internal Control & Compliance Establish and strengthen internal financial controls. Ensure proper segregation of duties and authorization procedures. Monitor compliance with company financial policies and procedures. Identify financial control weaknesses and recommend improvements. Minimize financial errors, unauthorized transactions and potential fraud risks. Conduct periodic review of financial processes and supporting documentation. Ensure proper safeguarding of company assets and financial records management informed of significant changes in applicable financial, VAT and tax requirements. 10. Audit Management Coordinate internal and external audit activities. Prepare audit schedules, supporting documents and financial information. Respond to audit queries and coordinate timely resolution of audit observations. Maintain proper audit trails and supporting documentation. Follow up on implementation of agreed audit recommendations. 11. Cost Control & Profitability Analysis Monitor operational and administrative expenses. Analyze cost structures of different service contracts and business units. Support management in determining service profitability and cost efficiency. Analyze manpower-related costs, overtime, allowances and other major operational expenses. Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising service quality. Prepare contract-wise or client-wise profitability analysis where required. 12. Security Services Contract Financial Management Review financial aspects of security-service contracts before implementation. Assist management in evaluating manpower costs, statutory costs, allowances, bonuses and other contract-related expenses. Monitor contract revenue versus operational costs. Ensure timely billing according to agreed contract terms. Highlight contracts with significant margin pressure, delayed payments or financial risks. Support the Operations and Business Development Teams with financial information for quotations and proposals. 13. MIS & Management Support Prepare regular financial MIS for senior management. Develop financial KPIs and dashboards. Provide management with financial analysis and recommendations. Support strategic decision-making through accurate financial information. Prepare ad-hoc financial reports and analysis as required by management. 14. Team Management Supervise, guide and develop the Accounts & Finance Team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance. Establish appropriate accounting procedures and reporting timelines. Train team members on accounting systems, internal controls and company procedures. Conduct performance reviews and recommend training or development requirements. 15. Other Responsibilities Coordinate with banks, auditors, consultants, vendors, clients and regulatory authorities as required. job_description: The Officer-Billing  is responsible for managing the end-to-end billing cycle for  Inpatient (IPD), Outpatient Diagnostic Tests (OPD), and Admissions.  This role involves accurate processing of patient billing using the hospital’s software system, ensuring timely invoicing, payment reconciliation, and coordination with clinical and administrative departments. The officer ensures billing accuracy, compliance with hospital policies, and provides courteous support to patients throughout the billing process. Key Responsibilities: IPD (Inpatient Department) Billing: Ensure final bills are prepared accurately and completely at the time of patient discharge , avoiding any discrepancies or omissions. Generate and manage inpatient bills  using the hospital billing software throughout the patient’s stay. Update patient bills regularly  based on all medical services utilized, including doctor visits, lab tests, surgical procedures, medications, and consumables. Coordinate closely with nursing, pharmacy, diagnostics, and other clinical departments  to ensure all chargeable services are captured and billed. Work under tight timelines to complete discharge formalities smoothly, ensuring patient satisfaction and billing transparency. 2. OPD (Outpatient Diagnostic Services) Billing: Accurately process and generate bills  for outpatient diagnostic tests, including pathology, radiology, and other investigations using hospital software. Verify doctor`s prescriptions and test requisitions carefully  before initiating billing to ensure correctness. Collect complete patient information and test details , entering all data accurately into the billing system. Politely guide patients through payment procedures , clarify billing queries, and assist them in understanding the process for report collection and delivery. Maintain a courteous and professional attitude to enhance patient experience during outpatient visits. 3. Admission Billing: Politely counsel patients and their attendants  regarding admission processes, estimated costs, deposit requirements, and billing procedures. Initiate billing for newly admitted patients  through the hospital software, ensuring timely and accurate registration. Verify and input patient records, admission details, deposit amounts, and initial service charges  into the system. Coordinate closely with the Admission Desk and relevant departments  to receive real-time updates on new admissions, cancellations, or changes in admission status. Ensure all billing entries are aligned with hospital policies and financial protocols. 4. Software-Based Operations: Operate hospital billing software for data entry, charge posting, invoice generation, and receipt printing. Troubleshoot minor software issues and escalate technical concerns to the IT team. Maintain accurate and timely electronic billing records and backup logs. 5. Payment & Reconciliation: Accept and record various types of payments (cash, card, bKash, insurance, corporate). Issue receipts and reconcile daily collections with the accounts department. Maintain proper documentation for insurance and credit clients. 6. Reporting & Documentation: Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly billing and collection reports. Ensure that all documents are filed systematically (both digital and hard copies). Submit required data to Finance and Management on time. 7. Patient Interaction & Support: Provide billing-related assistance to patients and their attendants with courtesy and clarity. Respond to queries regarding billing discrepancies, payment plans, or pending dues. Maintain professionalism and patient confidentiality at all times. 8. Compliance & Coordination: Follow hospital policies, financial guidelines, and SOPs strictly. Work closely with departments such as Reception, Diagnostics, Finance, and Medical Records. Adhere to shift schedules (morning/evening/night) as per duty roster.

ABOUT BANGLADESH SHOE CITY LTD. AND JENNYS GROUP Jennys Group is one of Bangladesh's established business groups with a strong foundation in footwear manufacturing, export, and industrial development. The Group operates across different entities related to the manufacturing and export of footwear to international markets. One of the Company’s keystone projects is Bangladesh Shoe City (BSCL) Ltd., a privately developed industrial manufacturing zone in Konabari, Gazipur built to attract global footwear brands seeking compliant, infrastructure-ready production facilities in Bangladesh. ABOUT THE ROLE As Jennys Group and Bangladesh Shoe City Limited expand operations, there is a growing need for a structured and reliable HR and administration function at the corporate level. The HR & Admin Officer will be responsible for managing the full spectrum of human resources, office administration, and corporate digital presence across the Group. This is a high-trust role with access to sensitive employee information, salary data, and confidential organizational records; absolute discretion and integrity are non-negotiable. The role requires equal strength in people management, organizational efficiency, and corporate communication, along with the ability to work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and staff across all entities. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Recruitment & Onboarding Manage end-to-end recruitment for all corporate-level positions — job posting, screening, shortlisting, interview coordination, and offer processing. Develop and maintain a structured onboarding process to ensure new employees are properly integrated into the Group. Maintain up-to-date job descriptions for all roles across group entities in coordination with department heads. 2. Employee Records & HR Administration Maintain accurate and confidential employee records for all staff across group entities — contracts, personal files, leave records, and attendance. Track and manage leave entitlements, attendance, and staff movements across all entities. Prepare monthly HR reports and headcount summaries for management. Manage the full employee lifecycle — from onboarding through to exit interviews and offboarding. 3. Payroll & Compensation Prepare monthly payroll inputs — attendance, overtime, deductions, and adjustments — and coordinate with Finance for timely disbursement. Manage festival bonus calculations and processing for Eid ul-Fitr and Eid ul-Adha. Ensure all salary and compensation records are accurately maintained and updated. 4. Labour Law & Compliance Ensure the Group's HR practices are in compliance with the Bangladesh Labour Act and all applicable employment regulations. Maintain proper documentation for all disciplinary actions, warnings, and grievance proceedings. Coordinate with the legal team on employment-related disputes, terminations, and regulatory matters. Keep all employment contracts, appointment letters, and HR policies current and legally compliant. 5. HR Policy & Staff Development Develop, maintain, and communicate HR policies and the employee handbook across all group entities. Ensure all staff are aware of and adhere to Group HR policies and procedures. Identify training and development needs across departments and coordinate relevant programs. Support staff welfare initiatives and maintain a positive and professional working environment. Ensure the office environment meets health and safety requirements in line with applicable regulations. 6. Office Administration Oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of the corporate head office — supplies, facilities, housekeeping, and vendor coordination. Manage office procurement — stationery, equipment, and consumables — ensuring cost efficiency and timely availability. Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, and logistics for management and staff as required. Manage the scheduling and logistics of internal meetings, management sessions, and company events. Maintain a proper filing and documentation system for all administrative records. Manage relationships with office service providers, landlords, and utility vendors. 7. Corporate Branding & Digital Presence Manage and regularly update the company's official LinkedIn pages, ensuring a professional and active corporate presence. Coordinate with IT or external web developers to ensure the corporate websites are up-to-date with current events, job postings, and organizational news. Assist in drafting corporate communications, internal announcements, and digital content that aligns with the Group's brand identity. Monitor digital platforms to ensure the company’s public-facing information remains accurate and professional. 8. Cross-functional Coordination Liaise with Finance on payroll, staff costs, and employee-related financial matters. Coordinate with Legal on employment contracts, disciplinary matters, and labour compliance. Support senior management with scheduling, correspondence, and internal communications as needed.

apply_instruction: HOW TO APPLY - READ CAREFULLY Following instructions is the first part of our hiring process. To be considered for shortlisting, you MUST submit a video of up to 15 minutes explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Applications without the required video will not be shortlisted. YOUR VIDEO SHOULD COVER: • Who you are and your current professional background • The experience you have that is directly relevant to this role • Projects, systems, products, or technical work you have personally built or owned • Your experience with AI coding agents and agentic systems such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw, or similar • How you have used AI agents, automation, orchestration, tools, or multi-agent workflows in real engineering work • Your experience with difficult debugging, production issues, browser automation, Chrome extensions, or complex software systems • The strongest technical skills you would bring to this role • One or two examples that prove you can solve difficult engineering problems independently • Why you believe you are capable of taking ownership of this role Do not simply read your CV on camera. We want to understand how you think, what you have actually done, what you personally owned, and why your experience makes you a strong candidate. YOUR APPLICATION MUST ALSO INCLUDE: 1. Start your cover letter with exactly: "I read the entire job description." 2. Include the link to your required video. 3. Include your GitHub profile, portfolio, open-source work, or other technically relevant work. 4. Describe the hardest technical bug you personally solved. Briefly explain: • What was broken • How you investigated it • What the actual root cause was • How you proved the fix was correct 5. Tell us which AI coding or agent systems you actively use and how you use them in a real engineering workflow. 6. Answer this question: "An AI coding agent creates a pull request that appears to fix the reported bug during testing. What would you check before approving it for production?" 7. Include your expected monthly salary in BDT. IMPORTANT: The video is mandatory. Submitting a CV without the required video does not complete the application and will not qualify you for shortlisting. Only candidates who complete the application requirements and demonstrate strong technical ability will move forward to the next stage. SELECTION PROCESS Our hiring process is intentionally challenging because we are looking for exceptional engineers. 1. Application Review We review your CV, video, GitHub/portfolio, experience, and application answers. 2. Technical Screening A technical discussion focused on your engineering judgment, debugging ability, AI-agent experience, and approach to difficult problems. 3. Paid Technical Challenge Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid, role-relevant challenge involving debugging, code review, Chrome Extensions, or agentic engineering. 4. Technical Interview We discuss your challenge, technical decisions, architecture, problem-solving approach, and experience with complex systems. 5. Final Interview A final discussion about ownership, expectations, compensation, and long-term fit. The process is designed to identify engineers who can take serious ownership of both production software and AI-agentic systems.

job_description: Assist in CABG Procedures Assist the Chief Cardiac Surgeon during CABG and other open-heart/cardiac surgical procedures. Participate in surgical preparation, exposure, graft harvesting, anastomosis assistance, hemostasis, closure, and other operative activities as directed. Maintain strict adherence to sterile techniques and operating-room protocols. Pre-operative Patient Management Assess and clinically evaluate patients scheduled for CABG under the supervision of the Chief Cardiac Surgeon. Review relevant investigations, including CBC, renal function, coagulation profile, ECG, echocardiography, coronary angiography, and other required investigations. Assist in pre-operative optimization and identification of potential surgical risks. Ensure the patient`s medical records, investigations, consent forms, and surgical checklist are complete before surgery. Intra-operative Responsibilities Provide direct assistance to the Chief Cardiac Surgeon throughout the surgical procedure. Assist with surgical instruments, graft preparation, tissue handling, suturing, hemostasis, and wound closure as assigned. Coordinate effectively with the anesthesiology, perfusion, nursing, and OT teams. Monitor the patient`s clinical status and immediately communicate any significant changes to the surgical team. Post-operative Care Assist in immediate post-operative management and transfer of patients to the Cardiac ICU. Monitor vital signs, drains, wound condition, bleeding, urine output, and other relevant clinical parameters. Assist in identifying and managing post-operative complications under the supervision of the cardiac surgeon and intensivist. Participate in daily post-operative rounds and communicate patient progress to the Chief Cardiac Surgeon. Patient Follow-up Conduct post-operative patient assessments and follow-up as directed by the Chief Cardiac Surgeon. Monitor recovery, wound healing, mobility, and other relevant clinical parameters. Assist in discharge planning and provide patients/families with appropriate post-operative instructions under supervision. Participate in outpatient follow-up of post-CABG patients when required. Clinical Documentation Maintain accurate and timely documentation of pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative patient care. Prepare and update patient progress notes, operative records, post-operative orders, discharge summaries, and follow-up documentation as required. Ensure all clinical documentation complies with hospital policies and applicable professional standards. Emergency & On-call Support Remain available for emergency cardiac surgical cases and urgent clinical situations as assigned. Provide on-call support for cardiac surgery patients and promptly escalate critical findings to the Chief Cardiac Surgeon.
